$comment: Routing rules live here, not in code (component 10). Call sites ask for an
intent ('chat', 'agent', 'classify'); this file decides which provider and
model serve it. Changing routing is a config edit and a restart, not a deploy.
A profile that names a provider with no credentials configured is a startup
error, on purpose — silently falling back is how you end up paying Anthropic
rates for work you thought was running on the Mini-PC.
To route cheap work to a local model once Ollama is reachable, set
then point 'classify' at it. fallbackProfile matters: if the local model
cannot call tools reliably, tool-carrying requests are routed to a provider
that can rather than getting prose where a tool call was needed.
